class ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode: GraphNode[Any]](_BaseExecuteGraphStep[GraphResult[TNode, GraphEdge]]):
    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode]) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def planning_contract(self: ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode]) -> StepPlanningContract:
        from l2070_batching.planning_contract import (
            FailureIsolationKind,
            FailureIsolationRequirement,
            PythonBoundary,
            PythonBoundaryKind,
            RecursiveQueryRequirement,
            RelationContract,
            ResultTransportKind,
            ResultTransportRequirement,
            SessionContextRequirement,
            SessionContextScope,
            StepPlanningContract,
        )

        induced = self._pattern.induced_subgraph
        node_type = induced.node_type if induced is not None else self._result_node_type
        if induced is not None:
            edge_type = induced.edge_type
        elif self._pattern.paths:
            edge_type = self._pattern.paths[-1].edge.edge_type
        else:
            edge_type = GraphEdge
        node_columns = tuple(
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(node_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in node_type.model_fields
        )
        edge_column_names = [get_db_column_name(edge_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in edge_type.model_fields]
        for required in ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id", "source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"):
            if required not in edge_column_names:
                edge_column_names.append(SqlColumnName(required))
        edge_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in edge_column_names)
        node_hints = _prefixed_graph_node_type_hints(node_type, node_columns)
        edge_hints = _prefixed_graph_edge_type_hints(edge_type, edge_columns)
        hints = _merge_graph_result_type_hints(node_hints, edge_hints)
        columns = (
            "__entity_kind",
            "__entity_id",
            *(f"__node_{column}" for column in node_columns),
            *(f"__edge_{column}" for column in edge_columns),
        )
        recursive_required = any(path.quantifier.max_hops is not None and path.quantifier.max_hops > 1 for path in self._pattern.paths)
        return StepPlanningContract(
            session_context=SessionContextRequirement(
                scope=SessionContextScope.NONE,
                validated_session_ref=None,
                permission_context_ref=None,
            ),
            result_transport=ResultTransportRequirement(
                kind=ResultTransportKind.RAW_RELATION,
                relation=RelationContract(
                    columns=columns,
                    column_type_hints=hints.filtered(set(columns)),
                    empty_result_allowed=True,
                ),
                cardinality=Cardinality.MANY,
            ),
            failure_isolation=FailureIsolationRequirement(
                kind=FailureIsolationKind.STATEMENT,
                rollback_scope_ref=None,
            ),
            recursive_query=RecursiveQueryRequirement(required=recursive_required),
            ordered_effects=(),
            python_boundary=PythonBoundary(kind=PythonBoundaryKind.CLOSED_APPLICATION),
        )

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode]) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "graph-result"})

    def compile(
        self: ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode],
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[GraphResult[TNode, GraphEdge]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory
        from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.steps.graph_traverse import (
            build_graph_traversal_compile_plan,
        )

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        induced = builder.pattern.induced_subgraph
        if induced is not None:
            target_node_type = induced.node_type
            edge_type = induced.edge_type
            grammar = builder._build_induced_subgraph_grammar()
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _graph_result_compiled_artifacts(
                target_node_type,
                edge_type,
                builder._graph_result_node_column_names(target_node_type),
                builder._induced_graph_result_edge_column_names(edge_type),
            )
        else:
            path, target_node_type, edge_type = builder._build_execute_graph_path()
            compile_plan = build_graph_traversal_compile_plan(
                ctx=ctx,
                node_type=target_node_type,
                edge_type=edge_type,
                direction=path.direction,
                dependencies=(),
            )
            grammar = builder._build_execute_graph_grammar(compile_plan=compile_plan)

        node_columns = builder._graph_result_node_column_names(target_node_type)
        edge_columns = builder._induced_graph_result_edge_column_names(edge_type)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _graph_result_compiled_artifacts(
            target_node_type,
            edge_type,
            node_columns,
            edge_columns,
        )
        graph_table = None if self._graph_type is None else get_table_name(self._graph_type)
        provenance_manifest = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                entry for entry in ctx.provenance_manifest_cache.values() if graph_table is not None and entry.table_name == graph_table
            ),
        )

        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            needs_recursive_with=_graph_grammar_requires_recursive_with(grammar),
            provenance_manifest=provenance_manifest,
            closed_post_op=graph_result_post_op(
                target_node_type,
                edge_type,
                node_columns=node_columns,
                edge_columns=edge_columns,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
        )


def _next_graph_result_internal_ref(ctx: LoweringContext) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    counter = int(ctx._lowering_cache.get("graph_result_internal_ref_counter", 910000)) + 1
    ctx._lowering_cache["graph_result_internal_ref_counter"] = counter
    return ServerPlanRefId(f"step_{counter}")


class ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode: GraphNode = GraphNode](
    IntentStep[GraphResult[TNode, GraphEdge]],
):
    """Own graph visibility and lower one backend-neutral graph result.

    The intent owns the permission relation so an empty result cannot bypass the
    visibility check. See ``docs/design/INDUCED_SUBGRAPH_EXECUTE_GRAPH_DETAILED_DESIGN.md``.
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "graph-result", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: Self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _GraphExecuteConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config

    @property
    def model_cls(self: ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode]) -> type[GraphNode]:
        return self._config.result_node_type

    def dependencies(self: ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode]) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(ExecuteGraphResultStep(self.ref_id, config=self._config).dependencies())
        if self._config.result_visibility is not None:
            dependencies.update(self._config.result_visibility.dependencies())
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def schema_model_dependencies(
        self: ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode],
    ) -> tuple[type, ...]:
        models: set[type] = {self._config.result_node_type}
        if self._config.graph_type is not None:
            models.add(self._config.graph_type)
        induced = self._config.pattern.induced_subgraph
        if induced is not None:
            models.update({induced.node_type, induced.edge_type})
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._config.pattern):
            models.update({path.source.node_type, path.target.node_type})
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                models.update({step.source_type, step.target_type, *step.edge_types})
        return tuple(sorted(models, key=lambda model: (model.__module__, model.__qualname__)))

    def lower(
        self: ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode],
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        visibility = self._config.result_visibility
        if visibility is None:
            msg = "ExecuteGraphResultIntent requires an owned graph visibility configuration"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
            VersionedSelectOneIntent,
            _VersionedSelectOneConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.return_value import (
            RequirePermittedRowStep,
            _RequirePermittedRowConfig,
        )
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import ServerRefs

        visible_graph_ref = _next_graph_result_internal_ref(ctx)
        visible_graph_intent = VersionedSelectOneIntent(
            visible_graph_ref,
            model_cls=visibility.graph_type,
            config=ServerRefs.scalar(
                _VersionedSelectOneConfig(
                    sys_id=visibility.graph_id_ref,
                    revision_id=visibility.revision_id_ref,
                    domain=visibility.domain,
                    include_deleted=False,
                    preferred_source=visibility.preferred_source,
                    permission_context_ref=visibility.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=visibility.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
        )
        visible_graph_steps = visible_graph_intent.lower(ctx)
        visible_raw_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{visible_graph_ref}.raw_rows")
        permitted_graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{visible_raw_rows_ref}.sys_id"),
            variant="scalar",
            type_hint=GraphId,
        )
        required_ref = _next_graph_result_internal_ref(ctx)
        required_step: RequirePermittedRowStep[Graph] = RequirePermittedRowStep(
            required_ref,
            config=_RequirePermittedRowConfig(
                source_ref=visible_raw_rows_ref,
                error_message=visibility.error_message,
            ),
        )
        terminal_config = replace(
            self._config,
            graph_id_ref=permitted_graph_id_ref,
            compile_context=replace(
                self._config.compile_context,
                graph_id_ref=permitted_graph_id_ref,
            ),
            graph_type=visibility.graph_type,
            after_refs=self._config.after_refs | frozenset({required_ref}),
            result_visibility=None,
        )
        terminal: ExecuteGraphResultStep[TNode] = ExecuteGraphResultStep(self.ref_id, config=terminal_config)
        publication_gate = self.publication_gate_requirement()
        if publication_gate is not None:
            terminal.require_publication_gate(publication_gate)

        route_guard: BranchRouteProofStep | None = None
        compile_context = terminal_config.compile_context
        resolved_branch_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{visible_graph_ref}_resolve_branch")
        has_resolved_branch = any(step.ref_id == resolved_branch_ref for step in visible_graph_steps)
        predicted_source = compile_context.predicted_source
        if predicted_source is None and has_resolved_branch:
            predicted_source = PublishedVersionSource.SPARSE
        if predicted_source is not None and publication_gate is None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_route_guard import (
                BranchRouteProofStep,
                StableRouteSnapshotRequirement,
            )
            from l2070_batching.step import PublicationGateRequirement

            if has_resolved_branch:
                route_guard = BranchRouteProofStep(
                    _next_graph_result_internal_ref(ctx),
                    policy_ref_id=None,
                    tip_revision_ref_id=None,
                    selected_revision=visibility.revision_id_ref,
                    predicted_source=predicted_source,
                    intent_ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    branch_ref_id=resolved_branch_ref,
                    branch_table=compile_context.branch_table,
                    revision_branch_index_table=compile_context.revision_branch_index_table,
                    route_hint_identity=compile_context.route_hint_identity,
                    stable_snapshot=(
                        StableRouteSnapshotRequirement.REQUIRED
                        if compile_context.requires_stable_route_snapshot
                        else StableRouteSnapshotRequirement.NOT_REQUIRED
                    ),
                )
                terminal.require_publication_gate(
                    PublicationGateRequirement(
                        guard_ref=route_guard.ref_id,
                        guard_step=route_guard,
                    ),
                )
        return (
            *visible_graph_steps,
            required_step,
            *((route_guard,) if route_guard is not None else ()),
            terminal,
        )

class ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]):
    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "graph", "query", "bindings"}
        if self._pattern.order_by:
            tags.add("ordered_result")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def json_aggregation_order_by(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        """Preserve graph row order inside backends that aggregate transport JSON."""
        recursive_path = (
            self._pattern.paths[0]
            if len(self._pattern.paths) == 1
            and (self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.min_hops != 1 or self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.max_hops != 1)
            else None
        )
        columns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for clause in self._pattern.order_by:
            field_path = clause.expression
            if not isinstance(field_path, str):
                continue
            output_column = field_path
            if "." in field_path:
                variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
                if (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    edge_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection) and projection.edge_variable == variable_name
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        _binding_edge_alias(edge_projection.binding_name, field_name)
                        if edge_projection is not None
                        else f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                    )
                elif (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    not in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    output_column = f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                elif recursive_path is not None and variable_name == recursive_path.target.variable:
                    scalar_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and projection.field_path == field_path
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        scalar_projection.binding_name
                        if scalar_projection is not None
                        else get_db_column_name(recursive_path.target.node_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                    )
                elif field_name == "sys_id":
                    projection = next(
                        (
                            candidate
                            for candidate in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if (isinstance(candidate, NodeBindingProjection) and candidate.node_variable == variable_name)
                            or (isinstance(candidate, EdgeBindingProjection) and candidate.edge_variable == variable_name)
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_node_sys_id_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                        )
                    elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            "sys_id",
                        )
                    else:
                        output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
                else:
                    output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
            columns.append((output_column, str(clause.direction)))
        return tuple(columns)

    def _cte_output_columns(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        columns: list[str] = []
        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                columns.append(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                columns.extend(
                    (
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
        columns.extend(column_name for column_name, _direction in self.json_aggregation_order_by())
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns)) if columns else None

    def cte_column_type_hints(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        if columns is None:
            return None
        jsonb_columns: set[str] = set()
        uuid_columns: set[str] = set()
        timestamptz_columns: set[str] = set()
        date_columns: set[str] = set()
        bool_columns: set[str] = set()
        integer_columns: set[str] = set()
        bigint_columns: set[str] = set()
        double_columns: set[str] = set()
        text_columns: set[str] = set()
        bytea_columns: set[str] = set()
        hint_targets = (
            ("jsonb_columns", jsonb_columns),
            ("uuid_columns", uuid_columns),
            ("timestamptz_columns", timestamptz_columns),
            ("date_columns", date_columns),
            ("bool_columns", bool_columns),
            ("integer_columns", integer_columns),
            ("bigint_columns", bigint_columns),
            ("double_columns", double_columns),
            ("text_columns", text_columns),
            ("bytea_columns", bytea_columns),
        )
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                if step.source_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.source_binding] = step.source_type
                if step.target_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.target_binding] = step.target_type
                if step.edge_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.edge_binding] = step.edge_types[0]

        def add_field_hint(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> bool:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return False
            variable, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable)
            if model_cls is None or field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
                return False
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return False
            for attribute, target in hint_targets:
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return True
            return False

        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.add(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                    },
                )
                text_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    },
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                integer_columns.add(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and not add_field_hint(
                projection.binding_name,
                projection.field_path,
            ):
                text_columns.add(projection.binding_name)

        order_columns = self.json_aggregation_order_by()
        string_order_clauses = tuple(clause for clause in self._pattern.order_by if isinstance(clause.expression, str))
        for clause, (column_name, _direction) in zip(
            string_order_clauses,
            order_columns,
            strict=True,
        ):
            typed_columns = set().union(*(target for _attribute, target in hint_targets))
            if column_name in typed_columns:
                continue
            if not isinstance(clause.expression, str) or not add_field_hint(
                column_name,
                clause.expression,
            ):
                text_columns.add(column_name)

        return SqlColumnTypeHints(
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(jsonb_columns),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(uuid_columns),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
            date_columns=frozenset(date_columns),
            bool_columns=frozenset(bool_columns),
            integer_columns=frozenset(integer_columns),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(bigint_columns),
            double_columns=frozenset(double_columns),
            text_columns=frozenset(text_columns),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(bytea_columns),
        )

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        """Publish result and ordering columns required by batched transport."""
        return self._cte_output_columns()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        # Graph bindings publish CTE contracts, so the helper names reflect the
        # SQL-visible publication invariant rather than runtime binding shape.
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = self.cte_column_type_hints()
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=GraphBindingRow,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(GraphBindingRow),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched

class ExecuteGraphAggregateStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "aggregate"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        group_field_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            field_name = str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            group_field_counts[field_name] = group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) + 1

        aggregation_aliases = {aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations}
        group_leaf_names = {str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1] for group_field in self._pattern.group_by}

        def aggregation_output_name(alias: str) -> str:
            return f"aggregate_{alias}" if alias in group_leaf_names else alias

        def output_name(raw: object) -> str:
            value = str(raw)
            if "." not in value and value in aggregation_aliases:
                return aggregation_output_name(value)
            field_name = value.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            if (group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) > 1 or field_name in aggregation_aliases) and "." in value:
                variable_name = value.split(".", 1)[0]
                return f"{variable_name}_{field_name}"
            return field_name

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            columns = tuple(self._pattern.overview_aggregation.output_columns)
        elif self._pattern.select_fields:
            columns = tuple(select_field.alias or output_name(select_field.expression) for select_field in self._pattern.select_fields)
        else:
            columns = tuple(
                [output_name(field) for field in self._pattern.group_by]
                + [aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations],
            )
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
        if not columns:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        aggregation_columns = {
            aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations
            if aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias) in columns
        }
        group_columns = set(columns) - aggregation_columns
        typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
            attribute: set()
            for attribute in (
                "jsonb_columns",
                "uuid_columns",
                "timestamptz_columns",
                "date_columns",
                "time_columns",
                "numeric_columns",
                "bool_columns",
                "integer_columns",
                "bigint_columns",
                "double_columns",
                "text_columns",
                "bytea_columns",
            )
        }
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            if path.edge.variable is not None:
                variable_models[path.edge.variable] = path.edge.edge_type

        def add_field_type(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> str | None:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return None
            variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable_name)
            if model_cls is None:
                return None
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return None
            for attribute, target in typed_columns.items():
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return attribute
            return None

        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            output_column = output_name(group_field)
            if add_field_type(output_column, group_field) is None:
                typed_columns["text_columns"].add(output_column)
        hinted_group_columns = set().union(*typed_columns.values())
        typed_columns["text_columns"].update(group_columns - hinted_group_columns)

        for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations:
            output_column = aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            if output_column not in aggregation_columns:
                continue
            function = aggregation.function.upper()
            if function == "COUNT":
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            if function in {"AVG", "STDDEV", "VARIANCE"}:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            source_attribute = add_field_type(output_column, aggregation.expression) if isinstance(aggregation.expression, str) else None
            if source_attribute is None:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
            elif function == "SUM" and source_attribute == "integer_columns":
                typed_columns["integer_columns"].discard(output_column)
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            typed_columns["text_columns"].update({"kind", "type_name"})
            typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add("count")
            typed_columns["text_columns"].discard("count")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint_columns"]),
            double_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["double_columns"]),
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["jsonb_columns"]),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid_columns"]),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["timestamptz_columns"]),
            date_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["date_columns"]),
            time_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["time_columns"]),
            numeric_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["numeric_columns"]),
            bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool_columns"]),
            integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["integer_columns"]),
            text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text_columns"]),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bytea_columns"]),
        ).filtered(set(columns))
        source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(_contract_model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None if source_tables is None else frozenset(str(table) for table in source_tables),
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(ctx)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_aggregate_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


def _graph_intent_dependency_contract(
    *,
    dependencies: frozenset[str],
    sql_visible: frozenset[str],
    auth_scope: frozenset[str],
) -> StepDependencyContract:
    return StepDependencyContract(
        consumed_refs=frozenset(
            ConsumedRef(
                ref=ref,
                source=DependencySource.GRAPH_CONFIG,
                required_for=frozenset(
                    {
                        DependencyUse.ORDERING,
                        *((DependencyUse.SQL_VISIBLE,) if ref in sql_visible else ()),
                        *((DependencyUse.AUTH_SCOPE,) if ref in auth_scope else ()),
                    },
                ),
            )
            for ref in dependencies
        ),
        transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
        materialization=MaterializationDependencyPolicy.NONE,
        reason="graph visibility and relation dependencies are explicit",
    )


class SelectVisibleGraphIntent[GraphT: Graph[Any]](
    VersionedSelectOneIntent[GraphT],
):
    """Permission-filtered graph-row producer with explicit visibility facts."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        graph_type: type[GraphT],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedSelectOneConfig],
        *,
        snapshot_revision_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, model_cls=graph_type, config=config)
        self.graph_type = graph_type
        self.snapshot_revision_ref = snapshot_revision_ref

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(super().dependencies())
        if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.snapshot_revision_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def graph_visibility_contract(self) -> GraphVisibilityProducerContract:
        graph_id_ref = self.sys_id.ref_id
        revision_ref = self.snapshot_revision_ref if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None else self.revision_id.ref_id
        branch_ref = None if self.branch_id is None else self.branch_id.ref_id
        if graph_id_ref is None or revision_ref is None:
            msg = "graph visibility inputs must be symbolic refs"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return GraphVisibilityProducerContract(
            role=GraphVisibilityProducerRole.VISIBLE_GRAPH_ROWS,
            graph_type=self.graph_type,
            output_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows"),
            source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(graph_id_ref),
            graph_id_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows.sys_id"),
            revision_ref=ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref),
            branch_anchor_ref=(None if branch_ref is None else ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref)),
        )

class RequirePermittedGraphRowStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """SQL-visible graph guard that preserves the permitted graph relation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        error_message: str,
        publication_contract: CtePublicationContract,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._error_message = error_message
        self._publication_contract = publication_contract

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"validation", "permission", "graph", "sql_projection"})

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        source_tables = self._publication_contract.source_tables
        if source_tables is None:
            raise ValueError("Graph validation publication must declare its source tables")
        return source_tables

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return self._publication_contract

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        delegate = RequirePermittedRowStep[object](
            self.ref_id,
            config=_RequirePermittedRowConfig(
                source_ref=self._source_ref,
                error_message=self._error_message,
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in self._publication_contract.columns),
            ),
        )
        compiled = delegate.compile(ctx)
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self._publication_contract,
        )
        return replace(
            compiled,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )
